name: Missed Check/Checkmate
desc: A forcing check or forced mate was available; played something quieter.

name: Missed Winning Tactic
desc: Missed a fork/skewer/discovery/threat that wins material (non-mating).

name: Missed Free Piece
desc: An enemy piece was hanging; failed to capture it.
mech: bw high, oh low, chk low

name: Missed Quiet Win
desc: A non-forcing winning move (trap, breakthrough, maneuver) was available.

name: Hung a Piece
desc: Move left own piece undefended / en prise, unforced.

name: Greedy Capture
desc: Grabbed material; the capturing piece self-destructs or a stronger move existed.

name: Pointless Check
desc: Gave a futile check that achieves nothing and hangs a piece.

name: Passive Play
desc: Autopilot/aimless move when the position demanded concrete action.

name: Ignored Tension
desc: Declined a necessary exchange / left pawn or piece tension unresolved.

name: Premature Aggression
desc: Unsound sacrifice or early attack that doesn't work.

name: Endgame Technique
desc: King-and-pawn / promotion-race technique error; no big material swing.
